ritual services or offerings in which the act is situated

items.question: At what point in the offerings is obeisance to be ritually assigned?
premises: The speaker envisions obeisance as part of the ritual act.
This envisioning of obeisance occurs afterwards.
The act takes place within the context of offerings.
items.inference: Therefore, the prescribed procedure is to assign obeisance after the offerings.
uncertainties: Whether kalpayāmi implies mental visualization or verbal utterance is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: I envision obeisance afterwards within the offerings; this is the prescribed procedure.
